creative_objective: Use the grid structure that already works for this brand to promise the main benefit honestly: appetite and energy to work on your curves. The four panels show four moments of the ritual over three weeks (drops, full breakfast, getting ready, training), not a changing body. Preserve the exact blocks of the source: two-line headline, 2x2 day panels, carton + bottle with sprig at bottom left, gold three-line plaque at bottom right.

art_direction.lighting_and_depth: Soft flat daylight, pencil-sketch shading inside the panels, soft contact shadows under carton and bottle, gentle brushed-metal sheen on the plaque.
art_direction.conversion_feel: The ad must feel persuasive, eye-catching, emotionally engaging, credible, elegant and commercially strong

visual_prompt: Square 1:1 ad on a warm cream canvas (#FBF3DC), clean and bright. TOP: a big, extra-bold, uppercase geometric sans headline in solid near-black, centered, in two lines with tight leading. MIDDLE: a tidy 2x2 grid of four equal landscape panels with rounded corners, a hairline pale-gold border and a slightly lighter cream fill, with narrow equal gutters. Each panel has a small bold uppercase metallic-gold day label in its top-left corner and a fine pencil-sketch illustration with soft color (realistic proportions, delicate hatching) of the same young Colombian woman, curly dark hair in a high puff, wearing the same beige tank top in all four panels, shown from the waist up, facing the viewer with a gentle smile. Her body is exactly the same in all four panels; only her action changes. Top-left panel: she squeezes a dropper over a glass of orange juice on a kitchen counter, the small amber dropper bottle beside the glass. Top-right panel: she sits at a table eating a full breakfast plate (eggs, arepa, fruit) with a fork, looking pleased. Bottom-left panel: she ties her hair up with a sports water bottle and a gym bag strap on her shoulder, looking energetic. Bottom-right panel: she lifts two small dumbbells in a shoulder press, smiling with energy. BOTTOM STRIP: at the bottom left, a tall rectangular lemon-yellow carton, slightly taller than the bottle, with the lowercase black wordmark 'amua' at the top and 'VITALDROPS' in white uppercase letters running vertically along the front face, standing next to and slightly behind the product bottle, both front view with soft contact shadows; behind them a delicate pale-gold botanical sprig line drawing. The product is a 60 ml (2 fl oz) amber-brown glass dropper bottle with rounded shoulders and a short neck, topped with a black ribbed screw collar and a glossy black rubber bulb dropper; the glass pipette is visible inside the amber liquid. A wraparound label covers most of the body with a smooth vertical gradient from bright lemon yellow at the top to white / pale silver at the bottom. On the label, from top to bottom: the lowercase black wordmark 'amua', the large white uppercase name 'VITALDROPS', a small dark line 'All-In-One Multi-Herbal Supplement', five small thin-outlined circular ingredient badges in two rows (A, MA, L on the first row; F, BR on the second) with tiny captions, and 'Dietary Supplement 2 fl. oz. (60mL)' at the bottom. The bottle is roughly 2.6 times taller than wide including the dropper. Use the attached product image as the only source of truth for the product; do not redesign, replace or reinterpret the bottle or its label. At the bottom right, a wide brushed metallic gold plaque (#C9A441 with lighter #E6CF7A sheen) with rounded corners and a thin inner border, holding three centered lines of black text: a small bold uppercase line, a much larger heavy condensed uppercase line, a thin divider and a regular-weight uppercase line with wide letter spacing. The area under the plaque stays empty cream. No price, no discount, no gift, no CTA button, no logo outside the product label and carton, no stars, no icons, no extra text.
